title: gloss-signature/v1
description: nodes/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml or targets/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml (F20-R8; D-3 v3.30): a steward's or curator's signature on one gloss version, affirming one sentence — I have read this against the Lean it names, and it says what the Lean says. It changes no grade, status or digestion state. Signed with the signer's own SSH key over the canonical body (opn_gate.signed), as explainer signatures are. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

node.description: The node, or null for a definition module's gloss.

gloss.description: The SHA-256 of the gloss file signed — its name under gloss/.

signer.description: The signer's GitHub login. At Stage 0 a real-identity contributor is an active steward of the target or a listed curator (F15-Q4).
